hintInstructions: The gate times are verified first entry and last exit, not an uninterrupted stay. Intermediate trips are omitted. A time span overlapping the theft is not an alibi.
gateSummary: First entry / last exit. Intermediate trips are omitted.
gateDetails: Personal identity checks, all perimeter gates and entrance cameras were audited. The displayed entries are the earliest arrival and latest departure in the investigation period. A last exit strictly before the theft window or a first entry strictly after it rules out presence during the theft. An overlapping span does not prove continuous presence or guilt. Day offsets, if any, appear in the time tooltips; day 0 is the day of the theft.
